module: Class that tracks a vehicle's placement and behavior on the road: current road segment (n1, n2), lateral position, alignment with the road, speed limit, legal side, and three fault scores (overSpeed, wrongWay, reckless) bounded from 0 to 1. It also handles light/stop violations via core_trafficSignals. Used by traffic to detect violations the police can penalize.
usage:
local rt = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/traffic/roadTracking')({vehId = be:getPlayerVehicleID(0)})
-- every frame:
rt:onUpdate(dt)
if rt.faults.overSpeed > 0.5 then --[[ speeding ]] end
notes: The module returns a constructor: the parameter (table) is turned into an object, and init(o.vehId) is called.
Fault scores are capped at 1; a value > 0.5 triggers violations on the police side (according to the code comment).
Speeds in m/s: speedLimitFloor = 4.167 (15 km/h), speedLimitCoef = 1.125 (12.5% tolerance before speeding).
sideValue: 1 = legal side/direction, -1 = illegal side, -2 = wrong way on a one-way road.
On a non-public road (type 'private' or drivability < 0.25), all faults are reset to 0.
Collisions are accumulated from map.objects[vehId].objectCollisions; they may be missed if dt is too large.
init may set self._invalid = true if the vehicle does not exist, but then still reads getObjectByID(vehId).initialNodePosBB, which crashes if the vehicle is absent.
highFrequency = true forces the road search every frame; fullStats is serialized but is not read in this file.

C.desc: A vehicle's road tracking object. Main fields: vehId, pos/dirVec/vel (vec3), speed, n1/n2 (road node names), linkData, speedLimit, speedRatio, alignment (~1 if parallel to the road), roadOffset, roadXnorm/roadYnorm (0 to 1), halfWidth, isOnRoad, isNearRoad, isPublicRoad, isOneWay, isReverse, legalSide, faults, timers, collisionIds, collisionCount, currSignal, signalAction, signalFault.

init.desc: Initializes the object: measures the vehicle's footprint (initialNodePosBB), computes vehBasicRadius (minimum half-width or half-length), sets the speed thresholds, then calls refresh.

vehId.desc: Id of the vehicle to track.

refresh.desc: Resets all tables and values (faults, timers, collisions, road), recalculates the legal side (right- or left-hand driving according to map.getRoadRules()), then, if the vehicle is in map.objects, updates the vehicle and the current road.

resetValues.desc: Resets the active tracking values to their neutral values (speed ratio, alignment, offset, faults, timers, signal, collisions).

updateVehicle.desc: Updates the ground position (OOBB center lowered by half the height), the direction, the speed (m/s) and isReverse (speed of at least 1 m/s in the direction opposite to the vehicle's front).

calcVehOnRoad.desc: Computes the vehicle's position on the n1-n2 segment: normalized longitudinal and lateral position, interpolated half-width, alignment, offset from the centerline, and isOnRoad.

returns.desc: true if the current segment is still valid; false if the vehicle has left it or the direction has changed (a new segment must then be searched).

updateCurrentRoad.desc: Looks for the best road segment (map.findBestRoad) for the current position and direction, updates speed limit, one-way, public road and centerline (from the lane string '+'/'-'), orients n1->n2 in the direction of travel, then calls calcVehOnRoad. If no road is nearby: isNearRoad = false and values reset.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame update: refreshes vehicle and road, accumulates collisions, then evolves the fault scores (speeding, wrong direction/side, reckless driving) and tracks traffic signals (red light, stop) to fill in signalAction and signalFault.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the configuration (vehId, speedLimitFloor, speedLimitCoef, highFrequency, fullStats).

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the configuration from the table produced by onSerialize.
